description:
Compute probability of detection (Pd) vs range for pulsed radar systems.
Inputs: Units, ranges and defaults are in each parameter's schema; one left out takes its default. Cross-parameter checks: probability_in_open_unit_interval. Time budget 300 s; waitSeconds (default 90, max 600) bounds the wait.
Example: {"frequency_hz":3000000000,"peakPower_w":5000,"antGainTx_dbi":35,"antGainRx_dbi":35,"noiseFig_db":4,"pulseWidth_s":0.00001,"nPulses":20,"swerlingModel":"1","targetRcs_dbsm":5,"rangeMax_km":300} (the "Surveillance Radar (Long Range)" preset)
Returns: The detection ranges at 50% and 90% probability, the SNR at maximum range, and the probability of detection against range with its 5th to 95th percentile band and the ROC curve described as series. Also warnings, provenance and the result page link; series are described, not listed (full: true returns everything). If waitSeconds runs out first: the jobId and progress, and the job keeps running.
Runs as a job on rftools.io and counts against the monthly run allowance (free lane without a key).

antGainRx_dbi.description: Rx Antenna Gain (dBi). Set equal to Tx for monostatic radar. min 0, max 60. omit for the default of 30

antGainTx_dbi.description: Tx Antenna Gain (dBi). min 0, max 60. omit for the default of 30

frequency_hz.description: Carrier Frequency (Hz). e.g. 3e9 = S-band, 10e9 = X-band, 77e9 = automotive mmWave. min 100000000, max 300000000000. omit for the default of 10000000000

full.description: Return the whole result payload instead of the summary. Large.

lossesRx_db.description: Rx Losses (dB). min 0, max 20. omit for the default of 1.5

lossesTx_db.description: Tx Losses (dB). min 0, max 20. omit for the default of 1.5

nPulses.description: Integrated Pulses. Non-coherent pulse integration count. min 1, max 512. omit for the default of 10

noiseFig_db.description: Receiver NF (dB). min 0, max 30. omit for the default of 5

peakPower_w.description: Peak Tx Power (W). min 0.001, max 1000000. omit for the default of 1000

pfa.description: Prob. False Alarm. e.g. 1e-6 for a CFAR detector. min 1e-12, max 0.1. omit for the default of 0.000001

pulseWidth_s.description: Pulse Width (s). e.g. 1e-6 = 1 µs. min 1e-9, max 0.001. omit for the default of 0.000001

rainRate_mmhr.description: Rain Rate (mm/hr). 0 = no rain; 25 = heavy rain; 100 = extreme. min 0, max 150. omit for the default of 0

rangeMax_km.description: Max Range (km). min 1, max 2000. omit for the default of 100

swerlingModel.description: Swerling Model. Target RCS fluctuation model. omit for the default of "1"

targetRcs_dbsm.description: Target RCS (mean) (dBsm). 0 dBsm = 1 m²; fighter aircraft ≈ 0–5 dBsm. min -40, max 60. omit for the default of 0

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the result before returning the job id (0 = submit and return at once, max 600).

name: simulate_radar_detection
title: Radar Detection Performance Monte Carlo
